title: Chengdu J-10C

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The J-10C is the modernised J-10 with an AESA radar (a radar that steers its beam electronically), an infrared search sensor, a new air intake, larger colour screens and a helmet sight. The cockpit layout and the grips are taken as those of the J-10A, so this guide follows the J-10A guide.
